unavailable.noAnswer: no answer from the account page
unavailable.accountPage: the account page did not load
unavailable.noGamesList: Steam answered without a games list (private game details or a temporary API error)
unavailable.storePage: the store page did not load

signIn.windowOpen: A sign-in window is already open
signIn.title: Sign in to {store}

confirm.ea: Confirm the install in the EA app
confirm.epic: Confirm the install in the Epic Games Launcher
confirm.gog: Confirm the install in GOG Galaxy
confirm.ubisoft: Confirm the install in Ubisoft Connect
confirm.xbox: Press Install in the Xbox app

install.battlenetMissing: Battle.net is not installed: install it from blizzard.com to install and play these games.
install.battlenetClassic: {title} is a classic game: download it from the Battle.net app's Classic Games section.
install.battlenetUnknown: This game is not known to Battle.net, so it cannot be installed from here.
install.eaMissing: The EA app is not installed: install it from ea.com/ea-app to install and play these games.
install.otherStore: This game is managed by another store; install it there.
install.eaNoId: This game has no EA content id, so the EA app cannot install it.
install.epicNoId: This game has no Epic app name, so the Epic Games Launcher cannot install it.
install.epicMissing: The Epic Games Launcher is not installed: install it from epicgames.com to install and play these games.
install.gogNoId: This game has no GOG product id, so GOG Galaxy cannot install it.
install.gogMissing: GOG Galaxy is not installed: install it from gog.com/galaxy, or download the offline installer from gog.com/account.
install.steamNoId: This game has no Steam app id, so Steam cannot install it.
install.steamMissing: Steam is not installed: install it from steampowered.com to install and play these games.
install.ubisoftNoId: This game has no Ubisoft launch id, so Ubisoft Connect cannot install it.
install.ubisoftMissing: Ubisoft Connect is not installed: install it from ubisoft.com/ubisoft-connect to install and play these games.
install.xboxNoId: This game has no Microsoft Store product id, so the Xbox app cannot install it.
install.notFromStore: This game is not from a store, so there is nothing to install.

token.epic: Epic did not return a token
token.gog: GOG did not return a token
token.gogUser: GOG did not return a user id
token.xboxUser: Xbox Live did not return a user token
token.xsts: Xbox Live did not return an XSTS token
token.microsoft: Microsoft did not return a token

ubisoft.noSignIn: Ubisoft does not offer a sign-in that PlayOut can use; your owned games come from the Ubisoft Connect client.

apiKeySignOut: Steam is signed in with the Web API key from Settings > Metadata; clear it there to sign out.
sessionExpiredStore: Session expired, sign in again to refresh your {store} library

failure.server: {owner} servers are not responding right now ({code}). This is a problem on {owner} side, not in PlayOut.
failure.rateLimit: {store} is limiting requests right now ({code}). This is on {owner} side, not in PlayOut.
failure.timeout: {store} did not answer in time. {owner} servers may be overloaded, or your internet connection may be slow or down.
failure.timeoutWhy: {store} did not answer in time ({detail}). {owner} servers may be overloaded, or your internet connection may be slow or down.
failure.network: Could not reach {store}. Your internet connection may be down, or {owner} servers may be having trouble.
failure.networkWhy: Could not reach {store} ({detail}). Your internet connection may be down, or {owner} servers may be having trouble.
failure.retryIn: PlayOut will try again in {minutes} minutes.
failure.importLater: Import again later to try once more.
